summary: Two decades of experience and a large listing base are strengths, but a form with no contact fields and conflicting claims appear to cost you buyers.

findings.problem: The inquiry form appears to list only Inquiry Type and Property details before Send Inquiry, with no visible name, email or phone fields.
findings.cost: A buyer cannot leave contact details.
findings.fix: A complete enquiry form with WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The form appears to say 'Available 24/7' while the footer says Mon to Sat 9am to 7pm GST, and a banner promotes Binayah.ae while the site runs on binayah.com.
findings.cost: Conflicting hours and domains confuse clients.
findings.fix: One set of hours and one domain message.

findings.problem: Hero tags Palm Jumeirah and Downtown Dubai appear to link to #, a townhouse link appears to point to the penthouses page, and prices appear as 'Starting From 11,232,888' with no currency.
findings.cost: Dead links and unclear prices lose serious buyers.
findings.fix: Working search tags and clear AED prices.

findings.problem: Award badges, news cards and the Latest Dubai Projects block appear twice, and the page cites 'Based on 152 reviews' but shows only a few.
findings.cost: Repeated blocks and thin proof look careless.

redesign: One set of hours and domain.
Working links, clear prices, visible reviews.
